item.title: Cleaner Code with Async and Await
item.description: Just when we thought Promises with .then() and .catch() were peak elegance, ES2017 dropped a game changer: async and await. If you’ve ever looked at long Promise chains and wished you could just write asynchronous code that reads like everyday synchronous code… well, your wish was granted. :D The Magic Formula Under the hood, async / await is just comfortable syntactic sugar built right on top of Promises.
